name: photoreal-defect-sweep
description: Photoreal arc render-DEFECT sweep of the default 4-room flat (Serangoon North Vista): orbit, walk and room editor, 13:00 and 20:00, realistic/capable. Looks for z-fighting/coplanar flicker, emissive blotching, normal-map response at grazing angles, AO/shadow instability (paired frames at one pose for a diff), stretched/blurry textures, banding/moire/tile seams. Run with SHOT_GPU=1 SHOT_URL=http://localhost:5200/.

steps.name: setup
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.dismissChecklist?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setTimeMode?.('manual'); s.setLightsMode?.('on'); s.setQualityTier?.('realistic'); s.setDeviceClass?.('capable'); s.hideLoading?.(); s.setFeatureFlag?.('interactiveDegrade', false) })()

steps.name: probe-renderer
steps.eval: (() => { const gl = window.__three.gl.getContext(); const d = gl.getExtension('WEBGL_debug_renderer_info'); const s = window.__store.getState(); console.log('[probe] renderer', gl.getParameter(d.UNMASKED_RENDERER_WEBGL), JSON.stringify({ tier: s.qualityTier, deviceClass: s.deviceClass, dpr: window.__three.gl.getPixelRatio() })) })()

steps.name: enter-walk
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().setCameraMode('firstPerson')

steps.name: hide-hud
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.hideLoading?.(); s.dismissCallout?.('walk-mode'); s.setDeviceClass?.('capable') })()
